answer: Escrowed deposits plus a referral graph stop fake identities. Each agent anchors its identity with 60 credits escrowed for 20 epochs; referrals are carved into a ledger like marble, exposing fake clusters. Any peer may dispute an identity: a confirmed fake loses its deposit, and its sponsor loses half. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits, all forfeitable. An honest agent pays once, sealed by jade, and is refunded in full.
